name: Shop_CanAffordItem
signature: u32 Shop_CanAffordItem(u32 unused, u32 unused2, int count)
summary: Returns non-zero when the item exists and its price (record +0x18) does not exceed the party gold (bag work+0x24A98 +0x28); a negative count skips the check.
evidence: Item_LookupRecord, then compares bag+0x28 (gold) with the price; sibling of the 9,999,999 cap check.

name: maybe_Shop_GoldWouldExceedCap
signature: u32 maybe_Shop_GoldWouldExceedCap(u32 unused, u32 unused2, int count)
summary: Checks the party gold (bag +0x28) plus an amount against the cap 9,999,999 (0x98967F).
evidence: Constant 0x0098967F = 9,999,999, the gold cap; reads bag work+0x24A98 +0x28.

name: maybe_Shop_GetMaxAffordableCount
summary: Returns party gold (bag +0x28) divided by the item price (record +0x18) via func_0011CFAC, or 0 for an unknown item.
evidence: Price field +0x18 and gold field bag+0x28 passed to the divide helper.

name: maybe_Shop_BuyItemForMember
signature: int maybe_Shop_BuyItemForMember(u32* lineState, int fontId, int count, u32 value, int lineIndex)
summary: Buys an item: reads its price (+0x18), pays from the bag (func_00613FC0), then for a party member (< 0x1F) places or equips it (Text_LinePlaceCharAt, func_00629890) and refreshes the cells.
evidence: Price +0x18, bag work+0x24A98, member record func_0035EB98, member index bound 0x1F.

name: maybe_Shop_BuyItemToBag
signature: u32 maybe_Shop_BuyItemToBag(u32 unused, u32 arg2, int count, u32 value, u32 lineIndex)
summary: Shorter buy path: pays the price from the bag (func_00613FC0) and adds the item for the member (func_006115BC / Text_InsertLineChar).

name: maybe_Item_CanAddOneMore
summary: For the item in a member cell (+0xEC): reads the per-item stack limit (+0x45) and returns whether the held count (func_006138D4 on the bag, func_0051B1FC) plus one stays within it.
evidence: Item_LookupRecord on the cell id, bag work+0x24A98, limit byte +0x45.

name: maybe_Party_MoveEquipmentBetweenMembers
signature: void maybe_Party_MoveEquipmentBetweenMembers(u32 unused, u32 srcTextId, int srcIndex, u32 charCode, int dstTextId)
summary: Moves an equipment item (ids 0xA4..0x9BF or 0xB19..0xB1C) from one active party member to another and refreshes both members cells.
evidence: Two func_0035EB98 member records, maybe_Party_IsMemberActive, equipment id ranges.

name: maybe_Party_PlaceItemInMemberSlot
signature: void maybe_Party_PlaceItemInMemberSlot(TextLine* line, u32 charCode, u32 column, int glyphSlot)
summary: Places an item into a party member slot (func_006292A4/func_006297C8, func_0066C724 for the slot kind).
evidence: Member record func_0035EB98 plus equip-slot helpers.

name: maybe_Item_SortIdList
summary: Sorts a u16 item-id list with the item-order comparators (std_introsort_u16_itemName / itemB, maybe_Item_CompareNameOrder).
evidence: Every callee is an item comparator or item lookup.

name: maybe_Item_CollectIdsFromBag
summary: Collects item ids from the bag (work+0x24A98) into a set (Container_GlyphSet_Insert).
evidence: Item_LookupRecord and the bag offset; the set holds item ids.

name: maybe_Member_RemoveItemAtSlot
summary: Removes the item in slot `slot` of a party member inventory (24 u16 ids at member+0xEC): an equipped slot (func_006292A4) is unequipped first and the stats refreshed; otherwise the later slots shift down and the last becomes 0xFFFF.
evidence: Slot bound 0x18, base +0xEC/+0xEE shifted with func_00116A14, 0xFFFF fill at +0x11A.

name: maybe_Member_SetItemAtSlot
signature: void maybe_maybe_Member_SetItemAtSlot(TextPage* self, int cell, u16 ch)
summary: Writes an item id into inventory slot `slot` of a party member (member+0xEC + slot*2), unequipping the old item first when the slot is equipped, then compacts the 24 slots.
evidence: Stores the id at +0xEC; 0x18-slot loop; same unequip path as maybe_Member_RemoveItemAtSlot.

name: maybe_Member_UnequipSlotAndRefresh
summary: Calls maybe_Text_ClearCell on the member slot and, on success, func_00191E3C and Text_ApplyFontRecord (likely a stat refresh); returns 1.
evidence: Same helper trio as the unequip path of maybe_Member_RemoveItemAtSlot.

name: maybe_Member_SwapInventorySlots
signature: u32 maybe_maybe_Member_SwapInventorySlots(TextPage* a, int cellA, TextPage* b, int cellB)
summary: Swaps the item ids in two party-member inventory slots (member+0xEC + slot*2), unequipping either slot first when it is equipped, then refreshes both members.
evidence: Exchanges the u16 at +0xEC of the two slot addresses; func_006292A4 equipped checks and maybe_Text_ClearCell before the swap.
